Attached: 1 video

Next week, I’ll be speaking at All Day AI 2026 about something Ive been experimenting with lately: System One models. AI models designed to make decisions fast, without lengthy reasoning.

To explore what they're actually capable of, I built a 3D drone simulator where an AI model has to navigate a forest, avoid obstacles, and react to threats in real time. Ill share what worked, what broke, and what I learned from zero-shot testing, collecting telemetry, and fine-tuning the model. Less theory, more lessons from building things and watching them fail.

Join me on October 22 at 5 PM ET.

#AllDayAI #MachineLearning #AI #OpenSource
